Tukreśvara
or Keśava, grandfather of Nāgeśadaivajña (a. of Grahaprabodha, NCC. VI. p. 252b).

Tukkādevī
wife of Kṛṣṇadevarāja an. daughter of Gajapati Pratāparudra of Orissa.
--Tukkāpañcaka or Ukhāº. ascribed. GD. 2068B. [Page194-a.
See Sources of Vij. History p.. 143-4.

Tukkāpañcaka
or Ukhāº or Ukhāyīº attributed to Tukkādevī.
See previous.

Tukkojī
I or Tulajā (1729-35 A. D.) Mahratta King of Tanjore an. patron of Ghanaśyāma.
See NCC. VI. p. 273b.
